HymnGenre.title: HymnGenre
HymnGenre.description: Represents a category or genre of hymns, used for organization and navigation within the app.

id.description: Unique identifier for the HymnGenre entity.

name.description: The name of the hymn genre, e.g., 'Holy Week', 'Kiahk', 'Resurrection'.

description.description: A brief description providing context or details about the hymn genre.

Hymn.title: Hymn
Hymn.description: Represents a specific hymn within a genre, identified by its title.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Hymn entity.

title.description: The title of the hymn, e.g., 'Tai shouri', 'Agios', 'Omonogenees'.

hymnGenreId.description: Reference to the HymnGenre this hymn belongs to. (Relationship: HymnGenre 1:N Hymn)

description.description: A brief description or contextual information for the hymn.

HymnRecording.title: HymnRecording
HymnRecording.description: Represents a specific audio recording of a hymn by a particular cantor, stored in the cloud.

id.description: Unique identifier for the HymnRecording entity.

hymnId.description: Reference to the Hymn this recording is for. (Relationship: Hymn 1:N HymnRecording)

cantorName.description: The name of the cantor who performed this recording, e.g., 'Cantor Tharwat', 'Cantor Ibrahim'.

audioUrl.description: The URL where the audio track file is stored in the cloud.

durationSeconds.description: The total length of the audio track in seconds.

isDefault.description: A boolean flag indicating if this recording is the default choice for its associated hymn.

description.description: A brief description or additional notes about this specific recording.

TrackMark.title: TrackMark
TrackMark.description: Represents a developer-defined point (mark) on a HymnRecording track, used to delineate sections for practice and navigation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TrackMark entity.

hymnRecordingId.description: Reference to the HymnRecording this mark is placed on. (Relationship: HymnRecording 1:N TrackMark)

positionSeconds.description: The precise time in seconds from the beginning of the track where this mark is located.

label.description: An optional descriptive label for the mark, e.g., 'Intro Start', 'Verse 1', 'Chorus End'.

defaultEnabled.description: A boolean indicating the developer's default state for whether this mark should be considered active for sectioning. Users can toggle this state at runtime, but this reflects the initial configuration.

description.description: A description of the mark's purpose or significance within the hymn, for developer or content reference.

definition.description: Top-level collection for hymn genres, allowing users to browse categories. All documents are publicly readable.

params.name: hymnGenreId
params.description: Unique identifier for a hymn genre.

definition.description: Subcollection of hymns belonging to a specific genre. All documents are publicly readable. Includes denormalized 'hymnGenreId' for explicit relationship.

params.name: hymnGenreId
params.description: Unique identifier of the parent hymn genre.

definition.description: Subcollection of audio recordings for a specific hymn. Multiple recordings can exist per hymn. All documents are publicly readable. Includes denormalized 'hymnId' for explicit relationship.

params.name: hymnGenreId
params.description: Unique identifier of the grandparent hymn genre.

params.name: hymnId
params.description: Unique identifier of the parent hymn.

params.name: hymnRecordingId
params.description: Unique identifier for a hymn recording.

definition.description: Subcollection of developer-defined track marks for a specific hymn recording. These marks include a 'defaultEnabled' state. All documents are publicly readable. Includes denormalized 'hymnRecordingId' for explicit relationship.

params.name: hymnGenreId
params.description: Unique identifier of the great-grandparent hymn genre.

params.name: hymnId
params.description: Unique identifier of the grandparent hymn.

params.name: hymnRecordingId
params.description: Unique identifier of the parent hymn recording.

params.name: trackMarkId
params.description: Unique identifier for a track mark.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to be highly scalable, secure, and debuggable, adhering to the core design principles and mandates. It primarily segregates public, read-only content from user-specific data, although constraints in the provided entity schemas limit the explicit definition of user-specific paths.
